digest.component_or_area: maintenance walks (fsck, compact-all) and archive operation
propositions: Store-wide fsck and compact-all scans visit every ticket directory including archived ones, making maintenance operations O(all tickets ever created) and unnecessarily slow as archived tickets accumulate.

The archive operation writes only the ARCHIVED event and .archived marker without folding, leaving unfolded tail events to be processed only by later compact-all walks that now skip archived tickets by default.

A shared active-only ticket directory iterator with an --include-archived override flag should be introduced to match the pattern already used by `ticket list`, replacing separate scan logic in fsck_scan.py and compact.py.
The `rebar archive` command must perform the ticket's terminal fold inline (via compact_txn) before writing the ARCHIVED event, making folding operation-linked and not dependent on scheduled sweeps.

Default fsck and compact-all scans should skip archived tickets (identified by .archived marker and net-archival state confirmation) unless --include-archived is explicitly passed, reducing operational scan time.
